templates.title: Continue · config.yaml (Native Anthropic, all models)
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.continue/config.yaml. Pick this variant for Claude models — it carries `reasoning` blocks, prompt-cache control, and citations end-to-end. Use the OpenAI-compatible variant for every other model; Continue auto-routes those to the OpenAI Responses endpoint internally, which is the feature-rich path on the OpenAI side.

templates.title: Continue · config.yaml (OpenAI-compatible, all models)
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.continue/config.yaml. Works with every model the gateway serves. For GPT-5 / o-series routes Continue's `provider: openai` block auto-selects the Responses endpoint for reasoning-capable models, so this template is the feature-rich path on the OpenAI side. For Claude models, the Native Anthropic variant keeps reasoning blocks, prompt-cache control and citations intact. One key reaches every model under the chosen provider; Continue picks up changes on save. Per-model `capabilities: [image_input, tool_use]` are declared when the underlying route supports them — without these flags, Continue silently rejects images and tool calls.

templates.title: Continue · MCP only (static key)
templates.instructions: Merge into ~/.continue/config.yaml alongside any existing models block. No LLM key is minted in this flow.
